title: [BUG] ToolUsage not using same I18N as Agent
body: ### Description The ToolUsage class defaults to using I18N() and has no way to update it. It should use the same I18N as the agent so that custom prompt_file's work properly. ### Steps to Reproduce 1. Make a new prompt file (like translation/en.json) and edit the `tool_usage_exception` message. 2. Set your crew to use this new prompt_file. 2. Have an agent use a tool incorrectly. 3. Observe that the error message sent to the AI does not contain the update from 1. ### Expected behavior The tool error message sent to the AI contains the updated wording from the prompt_file ### Screenshots/Code snippets I18N does not use a custom prompt_file. When ToolUsage is created, there is no way to set the prompt_file. ### Operating System macOS Sonoma ### Python Version 3.10 ### crewAI Version 0.70.1 ### crewAI Tools Version 0.12.1 ### Virtual Environment Conda ### Evidence Screenshots above show that the I18N never uses the prompt_file property set on the crew in ToolUsage and has no way of being set. ### Possible Solution When the ToolUsage is created, have it set its i18n to the same as the agent. I will open a PR for this. ### Additional context N/A

linked_prs.title: use the same i18n as the agent for tool usage
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/src/crewai/tools/tool_usage.py b/src/crewai/tools/tool_usage.py
index ebc9c5914e..f75a9443a3 100644
--- a/src/crewai/tools/tool_usage.py
+++ b/src/crewai/tools/tool_usage.py
@@ -59,7 +59,7 @@ def __init__(
         agent: Any,
         action: Any,
     ) -> None:
-        self._i18n: I18N = I18N()
+        self._i18n: I18N = agent.i18n
         self._printer: Printer = Printer()
         self._telemetry: Telemetry = Telemetry()
         self._run_attempts: int = 1
